description: Wraps POST /api/sites/{slug}/pause. Pause a site's checks. Stops every check of the site, keeping its history, until it's resumed. Nothing alerts while it's paused. It acts for the whole team. Needs an Admin key, on a team with 10 sites or more.
name: sites_by_slug_pause

slug.description: the site's slug: its id in every /api/sites/{slug} route

next_steps.description: calls that usually come next, each naming its tool

tool.description: the tool that makes this call

title: Pause a site's checks
